question: Which remaining skill ecosystem lane should OpenClaw own next: SKILL.md trigger/quality metadata, permission/provenance manifests, ClawHub publish/trust behavior, or bundle/agent-pack lifecycle?
rationale: The remaining work defines public ecosystem contracts and security boundaries across OpenClaw, plugins, and ClawHub, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API and ownership split.

options.title: Split and route remaining lanes
options.body: Keep #50090 as the umbrella only long enough to route trigger metadata, permission/trust manifests, install lifecycle hooks, and ClawHub publish bugs to narrow owner-reviewed issues.

options.title: Keep as roadmap umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad community tracker while requiring every implementation PR to cite a narrower accepted contract.

options.title: Close in favor of narrow trackers
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers designate canonical open issues for each remaining OpenClaw-owned lane and route external ClawHub service work elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Split and route remaining lanes
recommendation.body: Keep #50090 as the umbrella only long enough to route trigger metadata, permission/trust manifests, install lifecycle hooks, and ClawHub publish bugs to narrow owner-reviewed issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily product/security boundary ownership across core, plugins, and ClawHub, and steipete has the strongest current history on those surfaces.
